title: 浏览器返回
problem_statement_md:
你需要为浏览器制作一个 **返回** 按钮。

可以使用**栈**(Stack) 来存储访问过的网站链接。每一个新访问的链接都会**push**到栈中。
后退按钮需要从栈中弹出最上面的链接并导航到它。

给定的代码声明了一个**Browser**类作为栈，并实现了一些方法。然后，一些链接被**push**到栈上。之后用一个while循环来返回所有的链接并打印它们。

为**Browser**实现所需的**pop**()方法，使给定的代码按预期工作。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Stack[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need to make a [b]back[/b] button for a browser. 
You use a [b]stack[/b] to store the website links visited. Each new link visited is pushed onto the stack. 
The back button needs to pop the top link from the stack and navigate to it.

The given code declares a [b]Browser[/b] class as a stack and implements some of its methods. Then, some links are pushed onto the stack.
A while loop is then used to go back to all links and print them.

Implement the required [b]pop[/b]() method for the [b]Browser[/b], so that the given code works as expected. 
[note]Note, that the [b]pop[/b]() method needs to return the value, so that it can be printed.[/note]
hint_md: 注意，**pop**()方法需要返回值，以便可以打印。
